title: Corporate event terms feasibility

mechanism: Source feasibility only; contractual and institutional constraints are IDEA leads, not predictive evidence.

horizon: Successor holding horizons may span days, months or years; this audit has a two-hour wall-clock deadline.
informationSet: Eligibility, proration, deadlines, amendments, cancellation and broker processing requirements
primaryBaseline: No outcome evaluation in this source audit

evidence.summary: Registered but unexecuted; literature supplies inspiration only.
